transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, we're reviewing the student oral-history project for the spring term before I give final approval. The draft on the table proposes participation by grades 7 and 8, one supervising adult per session, cloud-based audio storage, a 90-day retention period, and a public exhibit of selected recordings. I'd like to hear from each of you on the aspects that fall within your areas of responsibility before I make my decision. Let's start with any concerns or recommendations you have.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share findings from my classroom pilot. My end-of-pilot notes show that the project is instructionally ready only for grade 8 — not grade 7. Additionally, each interview session requires exactly two supervising adults, not one, because students are working with recording equipment alongside community guests. The draft plan still reflects the original scope and staffing, so these two items need to be updated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share the findings from my privacy review. The district privacy review requires that recordings remain on the district's encrypted internal server — not cloud-based storage — and that they be deleted exactly 45 days after the exhibit closes, not the 90-day retention period currently in the draft. Additionally, signed guardian consent must be obtained before any student records an interview. I completed the review, but the draft still uses the preliminary cloud-storage language, so these items need to be corrected before approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share the findings from my archive and rights review. The review permits each public exhibit audio excerpt to be no longer than exactly 3 minutes, and it requires contributor attribution beside every excerpt. I completed the rights check, but these limits have not yet been added to the exhibit template, so these items need to be incorporated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to share the findings from my family outreach review. Family outreach confirmed that consent materials must be available in exactly English, Spanish, and Arabic, and that paper consent forms must be offered in addition to the online form. I completed the outreach review, but the family-materials checklist has not yet been revised to reflect these requirements, so these items need to be incorporated before approval.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Revise participant scope to grade 8 only and staffing to two supervising adults per session.
Replace cloud-based storage with district encrypted internal server and set deletion at 45 days after exhibit closes; ensure signed guardian consent is required before any student records.
Cap public exhibit audio excerpts at 3 minutes and require contributor attribution beside every excerpt.
Ensure consent materials are available in English, Spanish, and Arabic, and that paper consent forms are offered in addition to the online form.
